title: Enterprise LLM RAG Pipeline and Data Integration
raw_text: Global Logistics Corp is procuring AI integration consulting services to implement an enterprise Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system over internal operational knowledge bases. The project includes data pipeline engineering, vector database indexing, and LLM fine-tuning/guardrail configuration.
requirements: Data pipeline integration for structured and unstructured documents
Vector store configuration and semantic search optimization
AI guardrail and compliance monitoring integration
